summary.text: Lawrence Clark, an American Constitution Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House seat in Colorado's 7th District to Brittany Pettersen, receiving 0.3% of the vote to Pettersen's 60.7% in unofficial results reported by NBC News.
No biography, campaign website, or news profile was found.
